additional_files.description: Paths copied into the release, looked up in _files first, for example js/vendor/addon

minify.description: JavaScript files to minify into .min.js, or * for every file under js

rollup.description: Combined JavaScript files: the key is the output file, the value lists the input files

exec.description: Shell commands run before packaging. Every {name} is replaced with a scalar value of XF\AddOn\AddOn: addon.json keys such as {title} and {version_string}, fields of the installed add-on, {addon_id}, {addon_id_url}, {json_version_id}, {json_version_string} and {legacy_addon_id}
